scope.purpose: Independent 20,000-conversation insertion-order and mixed-field regression gate, not the 2M capacity or latency acceptance run.
scope.runtime: AOT Dart, production native encrypted SQLite search engine; identical frozen binary for both fixtures.
scope.environment: Shared development machine; runs overlapped separate large-corpus work and validation/build activity. No CPU isolation.
scope.memory: Full synthetic conversations and exhaustive in-memory reference retained by the probe. Peak RSS is diagnostic only; mixed fixture exceeded 2 GB. This does not measure the product capacity bound.
scope.timing: Each prepared sample follows a fresh worker open and explicit prepare(); open and prepare milliseconds are recorded separately. An immediate warm query follows. Three pairs per query/order are exploratory samples, not p95 estimates.
scope.correctness: All 120 returned ID sequences exactly matched the exhaustive SearchService top-100 reference. The mixed-field fixture also asserts that both project queries select 100 documents whose titles contain Project.
scope.isolation: Only freshly-created synthetic databases were opened. The capped 2M run and its databases/binary were untouched.
scope.limit: Some shared-load chronological samples exceeded 500 ms. The gate validates ordering and removal of full JSON page scans, not a universal latency promise or a 2M unordered-corpus latency result.

insertionOrders: Dart Random(42) shuffle of identical conversations
fixture.mixed: Project is present in every body and in exactly 200 titles (1%). Adds project and project grocery queries; keeps every transcript at 200 words.
fixture.goldens: Computed once per fixture, shared by chronological/shuffled runs and all samples, and retained in each raw report.

artifacts.laterSourceChangeExplanation: After compilation, root added braces around the codec boost-range guard to satisfy curly_braces_in_flow_control_structures. No behavioral change; the frozen probe binary was not replaced.
